t: You're on Savage Gardens, a minor street in the City of London. It links Crutched Friars to the north with Trinity Square to the south, crossing Pepys Street on the way. Part of it was pedestrianised in 2011, though the carriageway remains between Pepys Street and Trinity Square. The journalist and fiction writer Richard Steel Maurice was born here in 1827. He worked as a writer in Victorian London and died in 1868.
